title: Light Steamed Norwegian Tofu Tacos
description: A fresh and aerated lacto-vegetarian friendly Norwegian dish featuring hard taco shells and steamed tofu, perfect for a post-workout meal, served in a pandan leaf wrap.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Cut the pandan leaves into large squares to use as wraps.
Steam the tofu cubes for 5 minutes until lightly cooked.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat and saute the grated carrots and sliced zucchini for 3 minutes.
Add the steamed tofu to the pan and stir to combine with the carrots and zucchini.
Season the mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
Warm the hard taco shells according to package instructions.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the tofu and vegetable mixture into the taco shells and topping with shredded norwegian cheese.
Wrap each taco in a pandan leaf square and serve immediately.
